related.GL410641: Same 忍-11 yukihime art (earlier Suruga id). Staged under ps-yoyaku-gl410/; catalogue face is GL818534 → ni0011-a.

related.facts-ja: ni0001 variants[] already attested the 風雲姫 quote reprint
